methods.standings: Computed from finished CSV scores only; points 3/1/0; order by points, goal difference, goals scored, then displayed official order for exact ties. Cross-check compares statistical columns, not tie-breaking rationale.
methods.top5: Points, goals, defensive goals-against (ascending), wins/draws/losses. BTTS / over 2.5 rankings count qualifying matches divided by played games; overall/home/away cuts show their own denominators.
methods.projections: Descriptive independent-Poisson projection from this season’s completed home/away goal rates, blended with league venue averages; at least 2 applicable venue games needed for each side; no odds, lineups, injuries, prior-season data or player effects. Estimates are not facts or betting advice.

limitations: Only 8 matchdays (72 results) are completed by the cutoff; early season samples are small.
Schedule rounds 14–33 are listed as official pairings but source publishes only matchday date ranges, not individual dates/times; the dashboard preserves ranges rather than guessing.
No injury/availability feed or lineup data.
Tie-breaking rank order is supplied by the official DFL table; computed table validates match totals and stats.
DFL schedule times are shown in the source’s local German time where available; exact per-fixture dates/times are not yet scheduled for later rounds.
